description: AI agents are increasingly capable of performing economically relevant tasks previously done by humans.

instances.assertion: AI agents are increasingly capable of performing economically relevant tasks previously done by humans.
AI agents are increasingly being integrated into core business workflows to autonomously manage and execute tasks.
AI agents are increasingly used across industries for tasks like research, software engineering, and customer service.
AI agents are increasingly being deployed in business settings for tasks like onboarding clients, approving expenses, and customer service.
